newsitem.title: USA: Greyhound Lines to acquire Valley Transit.
newsitem.headline: Greyhound Lines to acquire Valley Transit.

text.p: Greyhound Lines Inc has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Valley Transit Company and various affiliated companies.

Valley Transit, a family-owned intercity bus company, serves South Texas and is headquartered in the Rio Grande Valley. Valley Transit was founded in 1941 by Vance Raimond, who remains its chairman of the board.

The acquisition of Valley Transit should be accretive to earnings, said Linda Crump of Greyhound's investor relations department. Crump could not say immediately how much the deal would help Greyhound's earnings nor in which quarter the accretion would begin.
"The importance of this acquisition is the strategic nature of it," Crump said.
She said Valley Transit is the dominant passenger transportation company in Texas' Rio Grande Valley.
"That marketplace and the foothold it gives us in moving into Mexico is what is important about the transaction," Crump said.
